lines: The queen squirmed on the ground for a moment, but soon curled up and stopped moving.
Hebiko was really surprised by the size of that thing...
That's because it was the queen...
Good job♪ Looks like the strategy worked.
The worker wasps also calmed down as though they had never been upset at all. They fell to the ground and are just sitting there like they're dead.
Shizuru poked one of the motionless, curled up wasps with her foot.
Even though Shizuru had fought against that many Devildomian Wasps, she wasn't sweating one bit.
(Seems I don't have to ask whether she's alright...)
Apparently there were even more Taimanin of great skill among the ranks.
(I guess I'll stop skipping her English class...)
What about the Devildomian Wasps that stopped moving? Even if they're not moving now, leaving them like this seems a bit...
The government will collect them as evidence. I called for backup earlier, so let's just leave them for those guys to deal with.
Hm? Where did those critters go?
What were they called again, Lilim and Minasaki? Given the way they moved, and their craftiness, it seemed appropriate to call them critters.
Minasaki, hurry up! You're gonna be seen by Chief again!
Even if you say that... it's pwetty heavy... hnnngh, haah.
Of all things, Lilim and Minasaki were trying to carry away one of the Devildomian Wasps.
Hey!!! Where do you plan on taking that...!!!?
The critters slowly turned to look at me, grinning broadly...
...And then they grabbed the Devildomian Wasp and ran away as fast as they could.
Hey, stop!! They're planning on trying to sell that off again somewhere, aren't they!?
What troublesome kids they are. Fuma-kun, let's go after them♪
You're their chief, right? So take some responsibility.
Like I said I'm not their chiiiiiieeeef!!!
(Those brats... They're definitely going to pay for this...!!!)
